clean_single_checkpoint: clean a single checkpoint file by removing unnecessary data and keeping only state_dict and meta
clean_checkpoints_in_directory: clean all pth checkpoint files in a directory by removing unnecessary data recursively
parse_checkpoint_args: parse command line arguments for checkpoint directory or single checkpoint path
run_checkpoint_cleaner_cli: run the checkpoint cleaner tool via argparse with checkpoint_dir or checkpoint_path options
skip_pretrain_checkpoints: skip cleaning checkpoints whose path contains pretrain/checkpoints to preserve original pretrain weights
